name: Peach Beach - The ENF Experience
source: Near the end of her vacation in Super Mario Sunshine, Princess Peach takes one last walk around Isle Delfino, during which a blooper steals her clothes. While she looks for a way to cover up, a Pianta sees her and calls the police about a naked woman on his property.
